title: Bodyweight Endurance Circuit - Weight Loss Focus

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly and deliberately, syncing breath with movement. Exhale as you round your spine, inhale as you arch.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Control the transition between sides. Keep chest upright and core engaged throughout the movement.

items.name: Butt Kicks
items.cues: Light and steady pace. Drive knees up toward glutes while maintaining light forward movement. Focus on cadence.

items.name: Burpees
items.cues: Maintain steady rhythm. Plant hands firmly, step or jump back to plank position, perform a push-up, then jump feet to hands and stand. Control your breathing—exhale on exertion.

items.name: Bear Crawl
items.cues: Keep hips low and core tight. Move opposite arm and leg together. Maintain a steady, controlled pace—this is about muscular endurance, not speed.

items.name: Bicycle Crunch
items.cues: Control the movement—no jerking. Bring opposite elbow toward knee with each rotation. Keep neck neutral and avoid pulling on head.

items.name: Bench Dip
items.cues: Use a sturdy chair or low surface. Lower body until arms are at 90 degrees. Keep chest upright and elbows close to body. Controlled descent and ascent.

items.name: Agility Ladder Run
items.cues: If no ladder available, use ground markers or imagine one. Quick foot placement, staying light on your feet. Drive knees up and maintain rhythm.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Lean forward against wall or support. Keep heel grounded and leg straight. Feel gentle stretch in calf muscle. Breathe deeply.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Place palm flat against wall at shoulder height with arm extended. Gently rotate torso away from wall. Hold stretch without bouncing.

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Slow, deliberate movements. Coordinate with breath to promote parasympathetic nervous system activation and recovery.

items.name: Deep Breathing
items.cues: Lie on back or sit comfortably. Inhale deeply for 4 counts, hold for 4, exhale for 4. Focus on bringing heart rate down.

rationale: User is returning from extended rest (999 days since last workout), so workout emphasizes moderate endurance work at RPE 5-6 with adequate recovery periods rather than high intensity.
No equipment available requires bodyweight circuit format. Mixed endurance and strength exercises create metabolic demand for weight loss goal while building work capacity.
40-minute duration uses 5-min warmup, 27-min main circuit, and 8-min cooldown to stay within target window while allowing sufficient volume for weight loss progression.
